tools.name: search_inventions
tools.description: Search the Unpatentable.org library of public-domain (CC0) invention disclosures by words in the title/summary, research domain, subdomain and publish date. Returns up to 25 summaries with URLs.

tools.name: get_invention
tools.description: One invention by id or slug: abstract, problem, section outline, domain, publish date, URLs of its 3 reports (main, Implementation Guide, Industry Impact), PDFs, Arweave transaction ids, GitHub repo and CC0 license.

tools.name: get_invention_text
tools.description: Full text of one report as markdown, in chunks. part = main | guide | impact. Use offset to continue; the result says the next offset.

tools.name: list_domains
tools.description: The 12 research domains with invention counts and subdomain counts (use get_domain for its subdomains).

tools.name: get_domain
tools.description: One research domain: its subdomains with counts and its 10 newest inventions.

tools.name: newest_inventions
tools.description: The most recently published inventions, optionally in one domain.

tools.name: library_stats
tools.description: Totals: inventions, reports, domains, subdomains, first/last publish date, inventions per domain.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_inventions, get_invention · Public sink: search_inventions, get_invention, library_stats.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_inventions, get_invention · Public sink: search_inventions, get_invention, library_stats

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
